full_description: FocusFlow is a productivity app designed to help you stay focused and avoid distractions. With customizable work sessions and break reminders, you can create a schedule that works for you. Set your work sessions to a specific length of time, and FocusFlow will remind you to take breaks and stay on track. Create a flow that suits your work style and increase your productivity with FocusFlow. Features include: customizable work sessions, break reminders, scheduling, and focus-enhancing tools to help you stay on track and achieve your goals.
